panels.title: Duration histogram — selected time range
panels.description: Estimated new observations per duration interval during the selected time range. Adjacent cumulative buckets are subtracted. Prometheus increase extrapolates at window boundaries, so counts can be fractional.

targets.expr: label_replace(clamp_min(sum(increase(demo_periodic_duration_seconds_bucket{job="histogram-sender",le="0.1"}[$__range])), 0), "bucket", "0.00 - 0.10 s", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(clamp_min((sum(increase(demo_periodic_duration_seconds_bucket{job="histogram-sender",le="0.25"}[$__range])) - sum(increase(demo_periodic_duration_seconds_bucket{job="histogram-sender",le="0.1"}[$__range]))), 0), "bucket", "0.10 - 0.25 s", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(clamp_min((sum(increase(demo_periodic_duration_seconds_bucket{job="histogram-sender",le="0.5"}[$__range])) - sum(increase(demo_periodic_duration_seconds_bucket{job="histogram-sender",le="0.25"}[$__range]))), 0), "bucket", "0.25 - 0.50 s", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(clamp_min((sum(increase(demo_periodic_duration_seconds_bucket{job="histogram-sender",le="1.0"}[$__range])) - sum(increase(demo_periodic_duration_seconds_bucket{job="histogram-sender",le="0.5"}[$__range]))), 0), "bucket", "0.50 - 1.00 s", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(clamp_min((sum(increase(demo_periodic_duration_seconds_bucket{job="histogram-sender",le="2.0"}[$__range])) - sum(increase(demo_periodic_duration_seconds_bucket{job="histogram-sender",le="1.0"}[$__range]))), 0), "bucket", "1.00 - 2.00 s", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(clamp_min((sum(increase(demo_periodic_duration_seconds_bucket{job="histogram-sender",le="5.0"}[$__range])) - sum(increase(demo_periodic_duration_seconds_bucket{job="histogram-sender",le="2.0"}[$__range]))), 0), "bucket", "2.00 - 5.00 s", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(clamp_min((sum(increase(demo_periodic_duration_seconds_bucket{job="histogram-sender",le="+Inf"}[$__range])) - sum(increase(demo_periodic_duration_seconds_bucket{job="histogram-sender",le="5.0"}[$__range]))), 0), "bucket", "5.00+ s", "__name__", ".*")
